app.title: PipePipe: NewPipe hard fork implementing SponsorBlock
app.author: Qision
app.description: Android video player based on NewPipe with integrated SponsorBlock support.
proposed_tests: Build the APK using Gradle and install on a test device.
Play a known video and verify SponsorBlock segments are skipped.
Measure startup time and memory usage.
Run the app with a network proxy to ensure SponsorBlock requests are sent.
